ar: اَللَّهُمَّ أَرِنَا الْحَقَّ حَقًّا فَنَتَّبِعَهُ ، وَ أَرِنَا الْبَاطِلَ بَاطِلًا فَنَجْتَنِبَهُ ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَاأَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ .
tr: Allāhumma arinā ‘l-ḥaqqa ḥaqqan fa nattabi`ahū, Wa arinā al-bāṭila bāṭilan fa najtanibahū, bi raḥmatika Yā Arḥama ‘r-Rāhimīn.
en: O Allah, show us truth as such, so we may follow it, and show us falsehood as such so we can avoid it, by Your Mercy, O Merciful of The Profoundly Merciful!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنَا بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ ، وَ أَغْنِنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ .
tr: Allāhumma ‘kfinā bi ḥalālika `an ḥarāmika, Wa aghninā bi faḍlika `amman siwāka,
en: O Allah, suffice us with Your lawful things rather than Your unlawful and enrich us by Your bounty from asking from others!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لَنَا أُمُوْرَنَا مَعَ الرَّاحَةِ لِقُلُوْبِنَا وَ أَبْدَانِنَا ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَ الْعَافِيَةِ فِيْ دِيْنِنَا وَ دُنْيَانَا وَ آخِرَتِنَا إِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ .
tr: Allāhumma yassir lanā umūranā ma`a ‘r-rāḥati li qulūbinā wa abdāninā, Wa ‘s-salāmati wa ‘l-`āfiyati fī Dīninā wa Dunyānā wa Ākhiratinā, Inna ka `alā kulli shay’in Qadīr.
en: O Allah, ease our affairs with rest for our hearts and bodies, security and health in our religion, worldy lives and afterlives, surely You are Capable of all things!
